title: Boolean conjunction function tester
statement: For each natural number $n$, define a tester for functions from the Boolean cube of dimension $n$ to the Booleans. It samples two Boolean vectors independently and uniformly, queries the function at those vectors and at their coordinatewise conjunction, and accepts exactly when all three answers are present and the conjunction of the first two answers equals the third.
